---
title: Teaching
---

I began teaching at the university level in March 2023. I mainly taught quantitative methods in the beginning of my PhD and since spring 2024 I am also teaching the Introduction Module on Population Geography and GIS for first-year students. Some of my teaching materials are available on Github for [population geography](https://github.com/sebhanika/pop-geo-teaching) and [quantitative methods](https://github.com/sebhanika/stats_teaching).

## Courses – Lund University

### Introduction to Population Geography & GIS

*Ongoing — runs twice per year (spring & autumn). Started spring 2024.*

* Currently responsible for five lectures on population geography, one seminar, and one lecture plus one lab in GIS.
* Focus on foundational concepts in population geography and introductory spatial analysis techniques.


---

### Research Methodology in Human Geography & Human Ecology

* Taught a quantitative methods and statistics module for students in both Human Geography and Human Ecology.
* Conducted lectures, seminars, and lab exercises.
* Graded assignments and supported students in applying quantitative methods.

---

### Applied Methods in Planning

* Delivered teaching on quantitative methods and statistics, across both spring and autumn semesters in 2023 & 2024.
* Conducted lectures, seminars, and lab exercises.
* Graded assignments and provided feedback on statistical applications in planning.

---

### Degree Project in Human Geography (SGEA23)

* Supervised a total of 13 students across from 2023 to 2025.
* Guided students on research design, data analysis, and academic writing.
* Acted as course convener in Spring 2025.

---

## Other Academic Activities

### Thesis Evaluation – EDSD / CED (2023)
* Served as committee member for a thesis defense at the Centre for Demographic Studies (Barcelona, Spain).
* Evaluated the thesis, provided feedback, and participated in the defense process.
